# Kirkco Corporation

> Kirkco Corporation, established in 1985 in Monroe, North Carolina, designs and integrates metering, mixing, and dispensing systems for polyurethane, epoxy, silicone, and lubrication manufacturing.

Kirkco is a systems integrator. It connects material feeding, precision metering, mixing, dispensing, controls, and lifecycle support into an application-specific architecture. The public catalog is the equipment, industry, and product pages below. Customer applications are discussed under NDA and are not published as case studies.
